newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Gwalia eyes lift in tantalum mines.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Gwalia eyes lift in tantalum mines.

text.p: Tantalum miner Gwalia Consolidated Ltd said on Friday it plans to increase processing capacity at its Wodgina tantalum mine by a third to over 200,000 tonnes a year by April.
This should result in production of about 180,000 pounds of tantalum annually, the company said.
The Wodgina mine produced 33,009 pounds of tantalum in the December quarter, Gwalia said.
Gwalia also said its Greenbushes mine produced 131,702 pounds of tantalum for the quarter with higher grades expected in the second half.
Gwalia said the two Western Australia mines would supply about 25 percent of world demand for tantalum annually.
Tanatalum is widely used in the electronics industry to make capacitors, paticularly those used in the manufacture of mobile phones.
